name: update_goal
description: Update the current goal. The goal state machine rejects illegal phase transitions and stale revisions; there is no caller authorization.

revision.description: Exact positive revision returned by get_goal.

action.description: Use edit, pause, and resume when the user requests them; use complete only when the objective is achieved; use blocked only when the same blocking condition persists across rounds. In a goal continuation round, blocked is rejected before the configured minimum round count.

objective.description: Replacement objective; valid only with action edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: Replacement cap; valid only with action edit.

blocked_reason.description: Required only with action blocked: the concrete condition that persisted across rounds and blocks progress.

prompt: create_goal may infer goal intent from a user request in any language. After session resume or fork, an active goal is disarmed: when the user asks to continue or resume in any wording or language, use update_goal action resume to rearm it. Mark complete only when the objective is actually achieved. Mark blocked only after the same blocking condition persists for at least {{blockedAfterConsecutiveRounds}} consecutive goal rounds, and report that concrete condition in blocked_reason; difficulty, uncertainty, or useful remaining work is not blocked.
